text:
maria: Quick sync — need clear owners + dependencies for the console observability work this sprint: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention migration. Who can take what?

sam: I can own tracing hooks (canary + staging). Will need infra sign-off for the tracing library bump.

olivia: I'll take dashboards (per-route, per-model latency + token-cost panels). Planning to reuse the new panel templates.

jess: Happy to own error-analysis views and alert query templates. Will add regression evals to the alert runbook.

maria: Thanks. Specific asks: sam — can you propose a canary plan? olivia — timeline for dashboards? jess — which alerts do you need from infra/runtime?

sam: Proposed canary plan:
```
- Deploy tracing-enabled build to staging
- Route 10% test traffic for 24h
- Monitor: P50/P95 latency, error-rate, KV cache misses
- Rollback if P50 > 2s or error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m
```

sam: Will open a short PR for the tracing flag and a test harness. pinging @infra-bot for approvals and kernel compat check.

infra-bot: INFRA-412 created: "tracing-lib bump + kernel check". Assigned to eng-infra. ETA 3 days.

olivia: Dashboard timeline: I can get baseline panels in 2 business days, full route breakdown + token-cost panels in 6 days. Need one dataset from eng-runtime: per-request model_id + route tags.
jess: For alerts I need: error counts by error_type, top error traces, and regressions vs baseline prompts. Can we get retention for trace payloads at 90d vs 30d? Longer retention needed for regressions.

maria: Retention discussion: product asked to keep detailed traces 30d by default, 90d opt-in for enterprise customers. For console QA we need 90d in staging for 2 weeks while we run evals. Can we do that temporary window?

sam: Staging short-term 90d OK if storage team approves. Long-term we need sampling to avoid costs — suggest tail-sampling + sticky sampling for flagged routes.

olivia: Dependency note: dashboards need the route tags from runtime -> add feature flag to include model_id in headers (small perf cost). Is that acceptable?
maria: perf hit expected small, but please quantify in the PR. If >1% p50 increase, we block.

jess: Quick question: who owns the rollout announcement copy in Console? I can draft but need owner to post.

maria: I can post the announcement once you draft. Include known rollback criteria and contact points.

sam: I'll start the tracing PR tonight (PROJ-789). tagging @deploy-bot to schedule a staging deploy after infra sign-off.

deploy-bot: Scheduled staging deploy for PROJ-789 on 1942080000, window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

olivia: I'll create the dashboard PR and link to PROJ-789 so reviewers can see the canary timeline.
jess: I'll attach the alert queries and a short check-list for runbook tests.

maria: Great. Action items: 1) sam: tracing PR + infra ticket (INFRA-412) 2) olivia: baseline dashboards PR 3) jess: error-view + alerts PR 4) infra: approve retention window for staging. Follow-ups in thread. :thumbsup:
